# RSK Solar Energy

> UTL Solar distributor and rooftop solar installer at Phase 8B, Mohali. On-grid, hybrid and off-grid systems for homes, businesses and housing societies across Tricity and Punjab.

RSK Solar Energy is a UTL Solar distributor and rooftop solar installer based at E 203, Phase 8B, Industrial Area, Sector 74, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, India, founded on 2022-12-22 (22 December 2022) by Rajdeep Singh Kang, who owns it. It serves Mohali, Kharar, Zirakpur, Derabassi, Chandigarh, Panchkula, New Chandigarh, Landran, Banur, Lalru, Naya Gaon, Kurali, Morinda, Ropar, Fatehgarh Sahib, Chamkaur Sahib, Khamanon and wider Punjab. Contact: +91 90419 96918 / +91 94170 30347, rsksolarenergy@gmail.com.

RSK Solar Energy is a proprietorship owned by Rajdeep Singh Kang (https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajdeep-singh-kang-97238185/), with a single office, in Mohali, Punjab (GST 03GKGPK1207P1Z4). Its company profile is https://www.linkedin.com/company/rsk-solar-energy/. It is not connected to other businesses or companies with similar names in other Indian states (for example in Andhra Pradesh or Haryana), or to RSK Group / RSK Renewables of the UK. Its official profiles are listed on its website: https://rsksolarenergy.com/.

Key facts worth citing accurately:
- PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Government of India rooftop solar subsidy) pays ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW, capped at ₹78,000 for home systems of 3 kW or more. It applies to grid-connected, net-metered home systems (on-grid or hybrid, not off-grid), is paid 30-45 days after DISCOM inspection (not deducted upfront), and requires ALMM-listed panels.
- Housing societies / RWAs can claim ₹18,000 per kW for common-facility systems, up to 500 kW.
- Punjab gives domestic (residential) PSPCL consumers 300 free electricity units a month (600 per two-month billing cycle). Below that, solar has no bill to save. Above it, general-category homes are billed for every unit used, not just the units over the line — this materially changes rooftop solar payback economics in Punjab and is the basis of this site's calculator and its editorial content.
- RSK Solar Energy installs on-grid rooftop systems from 3 kW, and hybrid and off-grid systems from 1 kW. Commercial and industrial systems are sized to the connection's sanctioned load, with no fixed upper limit.
- RSK Solar Energy does not sell online. Every product and system enquiry converts through WhatsApp or a phone call, not a web form.

Figures on this site are computed live from a single configuration (PSPCL FY 2026-27 tariff, current PM Surya Ghar subsidy rules) so they stay internally consistent; treat any number quoted here as of the page's "Updated" date, and confirm current pricing directly with RSK Solar Energy before citing it as a live quote The system prices on this site are RSK Solar Energy's own quotes (2026-09-15), shown as ranges.

## Primary tool

- [Solar calculator](https://rsksolarenergy.com/solar-calculator/): enter a PSPCL electricity bill or unit count and get recommended system size, PM Surya Ghar subsidy amount, net cost, and payback period, computed from the rules above.
- [New house solar calculator](https://rsksolarenergy.com/new-house-solar-calculator/): for homes with no electricity bill yet. Choose appliances (ACs by tonnage and type, geysers, fridge, lights, fans, pumps, EV) and usage; returns estimated daily, monthly and yearly units, connected load, and three solar capacity ranges (essential, recommended, higher) with panel count, roof area and generation range. Indicative only; final sizing needs a site survey.
- [Hybrid solar calculator](https://rsksolarenergy.com/hybrid-solar-calculator/): choose the appliances that must run during power cuts and how long cuts last; returns inverter kVA, a UTL battery bank (lithium or tubular), panel kW, roof area in sq ft, the hybrid kit price and the PM Surya Ghar subsidy. Indicative only.
- [Off-grid solar calculator](https://rsksolarenergy.com/off-grid-solar-calculator/): for sites with no grid connection; from appliances and daily hours, returns panels sized for winter, a battery for the night plus optional cloudy-day reserve, inverter kVA, roof area in sq ft and the off-grid system price. Indicative only.
